name: Methdilazine
summary: Methdilazine (Dilosyn, Tacaryl) is a first-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic properties of the phenothiazine class.

pharmacology.text: Methdilazine (Dilosyn, Tacaryl) is a first-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic properties of the phenothiazine class.

uses.en: It was used to relieve itching and allergy symptoms such as hives and hay fever.
uses.zh: 它曾被用來緩解搔癢，以及蕁麻疹、花粉症等過敏症狀。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被用来缓解搔痒，以及荨麻疹、花粉症等过敏症状。

sideEffects.en: It can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and dizziness, typical of older antihistamines with anticholinergic effects.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊、便秘與頭暈，這些是具抗膽鹼作用的老一代抗組織胺的典型副作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起嗜睡、口干、视力模糊、便秘与头晕，这些是具抗胆碱作用的老一代抗组织胺的典型副作用。

fact.en: Methdilazine is a phenothiazine antihistamine, from the same chemical family as promethazine, and it was sold as Tacaryl for itchy skin conditions.
fact.zh: Methdilazine 是一種啡噻嗪類抗組織胺，與普美沙嗪同屬一個化學家族，曾以 Tacaryl 之名用於搔癢性皮膚病。
fact.zhHans: Methdilazine 是一种啡噻嗪类抗组织胺，与普美沙嗪同属一个化学家族，曾以 Tacaryl 之名用于搔痒性皮肤病。
